description: PHP class definition for the ServerRequest object in the GuzzleHttp Psr7 library. It extends the Request class to add server-specific functionality such as handling server parameters, cookies, query strings, uploaded files, and constructing request objects from PHP superglobals. The class implements methods for normalizing uploaded files, extracting URI information from server globals, and managing request attributes in an immutable manner.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Represents an HTTP server-side request, extending the base Request class to include server-specific data such as server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, and input streams. Implements the ServerRequestInterface from PSR-7, ensuring immutability and standardized access to request information.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Converts an array of uploaded files, potentially nested, into a normalized structure with UploadedFileInterface instances, suitable for handling uploaded file data.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a $_FILES style specification array.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Recursively normalizes nested file upload specifications into an array of UploadedFileInterface objects.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object based on PHP's superglobals ($_SERVER, $_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES), populating request data accordingly.

methods.name: getUriFromGlobals
methods.description: Constructs a Uri instance representing the current request URI based on the $_SERVER superglobal values.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns the array of uploaded files associated with the request.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ServerRequest with a specific set of uploaded files.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ServerRequest with specified cookie parameters.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ServerRequest with specified query parameters.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body of the request (e.g., $_POST).

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ServerRequest with a specified parsed body.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns custom attributes set on the request.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value, or returns a default if not set.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ServerRequest with a specific attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ServerRequest without a specific attribute.
